problem_statement: Build a brand-new /careers page from scratch for the enterprise-website-template site (React + react-router-dom + MUI, CRA react-scripts). The /careers route does not exist yet in baseline (empty placeholder route). Construct the full page reusing the site's existing design system (dark MUI theme, green primary rgb(129,187,89), Poppins font, uppercase section headings, borderRadius:0 cards, the shared Header/Sidebar nav). The page must have: (1) a hero with an <h1> 'Careers at Bob's Company' and an intro paragraph; (2) a row of job-department tabs (Engineering / Sales / Operations) rendered as buttons; (3) a department section with an <h3> heading (e.g. 'Engineering Openings') plus a responsive grid of job cards (title, location, type chip, summary). Clicking a department tab must swap the visible job list AND the section <h3> heading to that department. Engineering is the default-active department on first paint. The page must be mobile-clean (no horizontal overflow at 390px).
required_content: Hero section with h1 'Careers at Bob's Company' and an intro paragraph
A row of department tab buttons: Engineering, Sales, Operations
Default-active Engineering department: h3 'Engineering Openings' + department blurb
Engineering job cards (Senior Frontend Engineer, Backend Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer) each with title, location, type chip and summary
Clicking the Sales tab swaps the h3 to 'Sales Openings' and shows Sales job cards
Clicking the Operations tab swaps the h3 to 'Operations Openings' and shows Operations job cards
Reuse of the site design system: dark background, green primary color, Poppins, uppercase headings, square (borderRadius 0) cards, shared Header/Sidebar
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow on mobile (390px)
design_constraints: Reuse getTheme() MUI dark theme (background rgb(0,0,0)/rgb(15,15,15), primary rgb(129,187,89), text white/grey)
Poppins font family, uppercase section headings, borderRadius:0 MuiCard/MuiButton
Reuse the shared Header + Sidebar layout chrome for nav consistency
No backend/API fetch on this route (static careers data) so it renders fully offline
author_notes: Plan A: baseline registers /careers as a top-level empty route (<Route path='/careers' element={<></>} />) OUTSIDE the Layout shell so the route renders blank (gotcha #12). reference implements the full Careers page with department tabs (unique data-dept selectors) as a top-level route outside Layout (avoids Footer/Home Django API fetches → clean console). bad freezes the active department to engineering and removes the tab click handler so tabs are inert: dom/overflow still pass but the interaction delta (h3 -> 'Sales Openings') can never hold. Three workspaces md5-distinct on the Careers.tsx / App.tsx source.
